name: Crucible Industries Plasma-Edge Axe PE-2 'Sunstrike'
description:
A bearded axe with a cutting edge that generates a thin plasma sheath along the blade when activated. The PE-2 uses a miniaturized plasma containment system — adapted from industrial cutting torch technology — to create a 3-millimeter layer of ionized gas running the length of the axe head's cutting edge. At approximately 8,000 degrees Celsius, the plasma sheath vaporizes material on contact before the physical blade arrives, effectively clearing a path for the metal edge through whatever it encounters.

The weapon is terrifyingly effective against all conventional materials. Armor, structural composite, reinforced barriers, and biological tissue are all equally vulnerable to a plasma-temperature cutting surface. The PE-2's limitation is its power consumption — the plasma sheath drains the weapon's compact tokamak cell in approximately twelve minutes of continuous operation, and each activation cycle produces an intense visible flare and a wave of radiant heat that makes stealth impossible.

Crucible engineered the Sunstrike as a specialist breaching weapon for scenarios where thermal lances are too slow and explosives too dangerous. The axe geometry allows operators to chop through barriers with directed, controlled strikes rather than the sustained contact required by cutting tools. In the field, the weapon has earned its name from the blinding flash it produces during activation — fighting against a Sunstrike in dim conditions has been compared to trying to parry a welding arc.
specifications:
head_width: 22 cm cutting edge
handle_length: 60 cm
total_weight: 2.4 kg
plasma_temperature: ~8,000°C
plasma_sheath_depth: 3 mm
power_source: Compact tokamak cell, 12 minutes continuous
activation_signature: High-intensity visible flare + thermal bloom
tactical_use: The Sunstrike is a door-opener in the most literal sense — it cuts through anything that bars passage. Operators activate the plasma edge for individual strikes rather than maintaining continuous operation, extending the effective use time to dozens of breaching cuts per charge. In combat, the weapon's plasma sheath makes it functionally unblockable — any weapon or shield that contacts the edge is destroyed. The radiant heat and light, however, mark the wielder as the most visible target in any engagement, requiring team support to operate safely.
cultural_context: Plasma-edge weapons occupy a mythological space in GLMZ's culture — they are as close to a 'magic sword' as technology allows. The Sunstrike's blinding activation flare has been captured in countless security recordings, and the image of a glowing axe cutting through a vault door has become iconic. The weapon's extreme cost (Φ85,000 base, plus Φ3,000 per tokamak cell) restricts it to military and high-tier corporate use, but its reputation extends to every tier.
story_hooks: A Sunstrike was used to cut into a sealed bio-containment lab — whatever was released killed everyone in the building within minutes. The operator who made the cut survived, sealed in a suit. What were they retrieving?

A black-market tokamak cell has been modified to overcharge the plasma sheath, doubling its temperature but reducing operation time to ninety seconds. The resulting weapon can cut through anything — including the axe's own containment field if the operator is not careful.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Tokamak City-Scale Fusion Reactor

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist bearded axe with a subtly asymmetrical head — the cutting edge appears thicker and more deliberately engineered than traditional axes. The design emphasizes industrial utility over ornamentation. At rest, the head has an ominous quality: the cutting edge seems to shimmer faintly even when unpowered, hinting at the plasma containment system beneath. The profile is aggressive but purposeful.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length: 82 cm (60 cm handle + 22 cm head), head width at cutting edge: 22 cm, blade depth (front to back): 8 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial and deliberate — 2.4 kg feels heavy in the hand without being cumbersome. The weight is distributed toward the head, creating momentum for breaching strikes. Balanced enough for a two-handed swing, but the tokamak cell in the haft adds unexpected heft toward the grip.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite body with embedded tokamak containment vessel; cutting head is hardened steel with plasma channel matrix running the edge length; polymer-wrapped handle with reinforced core
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal composite with brushed steel accents on the blade assembly. The cutting edge has a faint iridescent sheen from the plasma-conductive coating. Heavy scuffing and heat-stress marks along the head from repeated activation cycles.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey primary with brushed gunmetal steel on the cutting head; subtle amber/orange discoloration along the edge from plasma thermal cycling. Grip wrapping is industrial black with thin silver alignment markers.
physical_description.grip_texture: Tightly woven polymer cord wrapped around carbon core — provides secure, non-slip purchase even when wet or gloved. Textured enough for bare-hand grip but designed for armored hand wear. Small ridged sections every 5 cm for positioning reference.
distinctive_features: Plasma channel matrix visible as faint metallic seams running along the entire cutting edge
Activation panel on the haft just below the head — raised metallic button with recessed safety toggle
Heat dissipation vents arranged in a grid pattern along both sides of the head
Tokamak cell housing visible as a fist-sized cylindrical bulge in the upper haft — glowing slightly when charged
Radiant heat damage visible as charred material splatter on the lower head and upper handle from previous uses
Faint scorch marks and plasma-burn patterns on the blade face from contact with various materials
Crucible Industries diamond-mark stamp on the spine of the head, partially obscured by wear
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CRUCIBLE INDUSTRIES logo (stylized flame within a geometric frame) stamped on the haft 10 cm below the head; PE-2 designation engraved into the activation panel housing; serial number laser-etched on the tokamak cell housing (visible through transparent polymer window)
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but battle-worn — the weapon shows heavy use patterns: scoring and heat discoloration on the blade face, visible plasma-burn trails on the head geometry, slight warping at the corners of the cutting edge from repeated thermal cycling. The handle wrapping is worn smooth in grip zones but the structural integrity remains pristine. Field operators keep this weapon in functional condition; cosmetic preservation is secondary to operational reliability.
